name: Syston DIY / Firework Deals Store
observations: Native177: cream-painted two-storey brick facade, visibly weathered/flaking in places.
Two tall white multi-pane upper windows have black decorative lintel blocks and dark sills.
Broad pale fascia carries FIREWORK DEALS STORE lettering and Syston DIY/Hardware wording.
Lower left display window is crowded with tools/products; door at image-right is open/recessed in this view.
Brooms, buckets, racks and KEYS CUT HERE pavement board are separate shop props.
Black rainwater pipe and wall cables/camera fittings cross the upper/lower transition.
Do not infer a surveyed interior from clutter behind glazing.
unknowns: Exact dimensions, rear elevation and interior layout are not established. Street View address is a camera label, not this unit address.
review_basis: All listed captures reviewed in contact sheets; selected originals also inspected at native resolution. Notes describe visible appearance, not surveyed construction.
placement_confidence: Approximate frontage marker derived from camera route, side and estimated offset; not a measured footprint.
